name: Call to Elements
description: Grants you a boon that varies according to your location when casting this spell.
effects: grants a different Boon depending on your current location. For locations with no associated boon, Rage will be granted by default.

name: Mana Push
description: Spell which inflicts no damage but has High Impact in a wide area in front of the caster. Can be combined with other spells for powerful effects.
effects:
Push a powerful gust of wind forward with short range * Deals 1 physical damage * Deals 100 impact

Combinations:
• Sigil of Wind → Ethereal Bolt: long-range bolt, 25 ethereal damage, 100 impact
• Sigil of Ice → Frost Push: 85 frost damage, 60 impact, Slow Down
• Blood Sigil → Blood Tendrils: +50 Decay +50 Physical damage, +25 Impact

name: Reveal Soul
description: Reveal the blueish soul orb left by deceased thieves and adventurers. Certain spells must be cast within proximity of a soul.
effects:
Reveals the Soul Spots (blue orbs, see below) on fallen human enemies, and corpses. You may also find orbs on certain grave stones, as well as random skeleton corpses that cannot be interacted with. Casting a secondary spell near these blue orbs produces combination effects.

Combinations:
• Spark → Mana Spark: consumes the Soul Spot to restore 50% of max Mana
• Rupture → Soul Rupture: consumes the Soul, AoE blast of 100 Ethereal damage, 66 Impact
• Conjure → Summoned Ghost: ghost ally for 280s (20 Ethereal damage, 110 Health, 80 Physical resistance)

name: Weather Tolerance
description: +8 Hot weather def; +8 Cold weather def; +5 decay resistance

name: Jinx
description: Inflicts a random Hex debuff on the target.
effects: = * Will randomly inflict one of: Chill, Curse, Doom, Haunted or Scorched (equal random chance) on the target enemy * The spell can only be blocked by terrain and walls, it cannot be blocked or resisted by characters.

name: Nightmares
description: Reduces Max Mana burn from sleeping by 25%; Reduces Max Stamina burn recovery by 25%
effects: = * Reduces the rate at which max Mana is burnt when Resting by 25% * Reduces the rate at which burnt Stamina is recovered when Resting by 25%

name: Torment
description: Triggers a related reaction in all nearby enemies afflicted with a Hex
effects: = Triggers a related reaction for every Hex inflicted on all nearby Enemies: * Chill: 25 Frost damage, inflicts Slow Down * Curse: 20 Decay damage, inflicts Poisoned * Doomed: 20 Lightning damage, inflicts Weaken * Haunted: 20 Ethereal damage, inflicts Sapped * Scorched: 20 Fire damage, inflicts Burning * Pain: 10 Ethereal damage, inflicts Bleeding * Confusion: 0 damage, 50 Impact, re-applies Confusion

name: Fitness
description: +25 max Health; +20% health restored while Resting
effects: * +25 maximum health * +20% health restored from Resting

name: Shield Charge
description: Required: Shield Rush forward to hit foes with your shield for high Impact. Can hit the target twice.
effects: * Charge forward with Shield * Hits twice, once at the start of the animation and once at the end * Deals the damage and impact from the equipped Shield, as well as any Effects on the shield

name: Steady Arm
description: Increases Impact Resistance by 10 while you are blocking.

name: Armor Training
description: -50% armor penalty for Stamina cost and Movement Speed
effects: * Reduces Equipment movement penalties by 50%. ** Importantly, this only applies to the attributes "Movement Speed" and "Stamina Use" on equipment. It does not apply to general weight burdens from wearing too much heavy equipment.

name: Fast Maintenance
description: You repair your equipment 50% faster when you allocate time to Repairing in the rest menu.

name: Frost Bullet
description: Required: Pistol, Cool Boon Load the pistol with a bullet that makes a short-distance blast which slows enemies. Removes your Cool boon. Shooting it requires use of the Fire/Reload skill.

name: Shatter Bullet
description: Required: Pistol, Iron Scraps Load a bullet with high Impact which also inflicts Pain Shooting it requires the use of the Fire/Reload skill.

name: Chakram Arc
description: Required:Chakram, Discipline Boon. The disc sweeps the area in front of the caster, dealing high Damage and Impact. Discipline is required to cast this spell.
effects: * Close-ranged sweeping attack * Damage multiplier: 1.5x * Impact multiplier: 4.0x

name: Chakram Pierce
description: Required: Chakram, Discipline Boon. Launch the disc forward, possibly hitting the enemy twice. Discipline is required to cast this spell.
effects: * Can hit twice * Pierces through all targets

name: Mana Ward
description: Envelops you in Mana and, for an instant, you become immune to Damage. Can be combined with other spells for powerful effects.
effects:
*The caster is granted the Force Bubble status for the duration of the effect. *While this spell protects the user from most damage, it does not prevent Impact, meaning you can still be staggered or knocked down during the effect.

Combinations:
• Sigil of Fire → Immolate: +30% fire damage for 60s
• Sigil of Ice → Frost Burst: 100 frost damage, 60 impact, Slow Down
• Blood Sigil → Gift of Blood: +15% Physical/Frost/Decay damage for 60s

name: Sigil of Fire
description: Consumes: Fire Stone Create a magic circle on the ground. Certain skills have additional effects when cast within this circle.
effects:
* Raises the player's Temperature Stage by 3 (heats the player up). In neutral temperature environments this increases the player's temperature delta by +28 .

Combinations:
• Spark → Fireball: fast projectile, 60 fire damage, 60 impact, inflicts Burning
• Mana Ward → Immolate: +30% fire damage for 60s, receive 0.5 fire damage per second
• Flint and Steel → Ring of Fire: sigil burns for 25s, 24 fire damage per second, inflicts Burning

name: Haunting Beat
description: Deploys Ghost Drums on the ground, and causes Haunted in a small radius.
effects:
= * Deploy the Ghost Drum * Cannot be placed within 30 meters of another totem, unless you have Harmony and Melody * Continuously deals Haunted to enemies inside the ring. * You can strike the instrument once every 3 seconds to send out blasts. * Picking up the Ghost Drum will reset the charges to 0. If an enemy is in range, hitting the Drums with a weapon will: * Add a charge to the instrument when a blast hits an enemy, increasing the instrument's power. * Send out a blast dealing 10 Ethereal damage to nearby targets, and an additional 3 damage per charge on the instrument with a maximum of 40 base damage. The blast also inflicts Aetherbomb on enemies. **The Aetherbomb buildup starts at 20% and increases by an additional 6% per charge, with a cap of 100% at 14 charges. **The Drum's damage is affected by equipment and boons of the player who placed the drum at the time the projectile hits the enemy.

Combinations:
• Battle Rhythm → Ghost Rhythm: Ghost Drum increases Protection by 5 within 8m
• Nurturing Echo → Nurturing Ghost Drum: restores 5 Stamina and 5 Mana per second (2-16s)
• Reverberation → Ghost Reverberation: recalls the drum, damaging pulses (15-25 Ethereal + 10 Impact per second, 10-15s)

name: Miasmic Tolerance
description: Increase Status Effect resistance by 15% when well rested.
effects: = * When you have a Sleep Effect you gain 15% Status Resistance.

name: Welkin Ring
description: Deploys the Sky Chimes and causes Doom in a small radius.
effects:
= * Deploy the Sky Chimes * Cannot be placed within 30 meters of another totem, unless you have Harmony and Melody * Continuously deals Doomed to enemies inside the ring. * You can strike the instrument once every 3 seconds to send out blasts. * Picking up the Sky Chimes will reset the charges to 0. If an enemy is in range, hitting the Chimes with a weapon will: * Add a charge to the instrument when a blast hits an enemy, increasing the instrument's power. * Send out a blast dealing 10 Lightning damage to nearby targets, and an additional 3 damage per charge on the instrument with a maximum of 40 base damage. The blast also inflicts Holy Blaze on enemies who are afflicted with Burning. **The Holy Blaze buildup starts at 20% and increases by an additional 6% per charge, with a cap of 100% at 14 charges. **The Chimes' damage is affected by equipment and boons of the player who placed the drum at the time the projectile hits the enemy.

Combinations:
• Battle Rhythm → Welkin Rhythm: Sky Chimes increase Barrier by 5 within 8m
• Nurturing Echo → Nurturing Welkin Ring: restores 5 Health and reduces status buildup by 10% per second (2-16s)
• Reverberation → Welkin Reverberation: recalls the chimes, damaging pulses (15-25 Lightning + 10 Impact per second, 10-15s)

name: Backstab
description: Required: Dagger Dagger attack. If the attack hits the enemy's back, the damage and impact are tripled.
effects: *If the skill hits the enemy's back, it will deal quadruple damage and impact (4.0x). *If the skill does not strike the enemy in the back, it does the same damage as Dagger Slash. *The extra damage If the skill hits the enemy's back is processed as separate hit, which also triggers any Status Effects on the dagger again. This makes it possible to inflict statuses with one cast of Backstab.
multipliers: 1.0x Dagger damage1.0x ImpactIf hit enemy's back:4.0x Damage4.0x Impact

name: Opportunist Stab
description: Dagger attack. If the enemy has the Pain or Confusion hex, this attack's damage and knockback are tripled. If it has both, it is 6 times stronger instead.
effects: * Deals the damage from the player's equipped Dagger. * If the enemy has Pain or Confusion, Damage and Impact are 3.0x times stronger * If the enemy has Pain and Confusion, Damage and Impact are 6.0x times stronger * This skill will remove Pain and Confusion hexes from the enemy if they have them * Effects from the Dagger are inflicted on hit
multipliers: Enemy has Pain or Confusion:3.0x Damage and ImpactEnemy has Pain and Confusion:6.0x Damage and Impact

name: Pressure Plate Training
description:
Enable you to deploy complex Pressure Plate Traps.
These traps are primarily armed with charges, which shoot poison, fire and more.

name: Sweep Kick
description: High impact against Confused targets; Area of Effect Radius
effects: * A stronger version of Push Kick, dealing 20 physical and 85 Impact * If the target has Confusion, they will receive 99999 Impact, which is a guaranteed knockdown unless they have 100% Impact resist * Hits all targets in a small area-of-effect radius

description: Blue rune that does nothing on its own, but can produce combo effects by casting other runes in the correct order.
effects:

name: Acrobatics
description: Unhampered Dodge Rolls have increased range. Stamina cost of Dodge Rolls increased by 50%
effects: = * Unhampered Dodge Rolls have increased range (hampered rolls are when you have a backpack that restricts your dodge) * Stamina cost of Dodge Rolls increased by 50% (from 6 to 9)

name: Brains
description: Increases Elemental Damage by 15%, but lowers physical damage by 25% and increases Stamina costs by 15%
effects: = * Increases Elemental damage dealt by 15% * Reduces Physical damage dealt by 25% * Increases Stamina cost of actions by 15%

name: Brawns
description: Increase Physical Damage by 25% and increase max stamina by 25, but lowers elemental damage by 40%.
effects: = * Increases Physical damage dealt by 25% * Increases max Stamina by 25 * Reduces Elemental damage dealt by 40%

name: Cruelty
description: Increases the damage of DoTs, but reduces Status Resistance and Physical resistance
effects: = * Increases damage by 50% for: Burning, Poisoned and Extreme Poison * Increases damage by 30% for: Bleeding, Extreme Bleeding, Blood Leech Victim, Blaze, Holy Blaze and Plague. * Lowers Status Resistance by 50% and Physical resistance by 10%.

name: Patience
description: Increases damage of Weapon Skills by 30%. Lowers damage of normal and special weapon attacks by 20%.
effects: = * Increases damage of Main-Weapon Skills by 30%. This also includes Gong Strike, Shield Charge, Elemental Discharge, Bow skills and Dagger skills, as well as Push Kick, Sweep Kick and Frost Kick. * Reduces damage of normal and special attacks on weapons by 20%. ** It also reduces damage from combination attacks such as Standard > Special. ** It does not reduce damage from running attacks.

name: Unsealed
description: * In the Vanilla game (NOT Definitive Edition), the skill is bugged and does not extend Sigil durations. Category:Pages which list bugs
effects: = * Increases the speed at which you places Sigils, and extends their duration by 20 seconds. * Lowers your max Health by 25.

name: Efficiency
description: Maximum Stamina increased by 25.

name: Metabolic Purge
description: {{description|Passive skill that increases Corruption resistance by 10%.}}

name: Probe
description: A weak attack that increases Alertness level on hit.; Evolves into stronger forms as Alertness level rises.
multipliers: 0.5x Damage; 0.15x Impact; Can increase with higher levels

name: Brace
description: Blocks an attack, restoring your stability and giving you the Discipline boon. All nearby enemies are knocked back.
effects: Blocks an attack (can be melee, magic or ranged). If successful: * Restores Stability * Nearby enemies are knocked back, and the attacker's Stability is reduced to 50% The effects of Brace only apply if an attack was successfully countered. If no attack was blocked, Brace goes on cooldown and no effects are gained.

name: Focus
description: Grants the discipline boon, which increases the physical damage of your attacks. Using this skill burns a bit of your maximum stamina until the next time you sleep. Certain skills require this boon to be active.

name: Slow Metabolism
description: It takes more time for you to become hungry, thirsty and sleepy.
effects: The values with which this skill affects your stats are: * Drink deplete rate: -20% * Sleep deplete rate: -20% * Food deplete rate: -15%

name: Crescendo
description: Quick attack which grants Craze on successful hits.
effects: = * Quick attack, dealing 1.0x Damage and Impact. * Successful hits grant a stack of Craze.

name: Dispersion
description: Create an AoE shockwave which destabilizes yourself. Effect varies depending on Imbue.
effects: = Create an AoE shockwave on the ground. * Deals 2.0x weapon Damage and 1.5x weapon Impact * Reduces your Stability to 0, but does not stagger you. If you have a Melee Imbue on the weapon, the effects will vary: * Fire imbues: Damage overrides to Fire, inflicts Scorched. * Frost imbues: Damage overrides to Frost, inflicts Chill. * Lightning and Light imbues: Damage overrides to Lightning, inflicts Doomed. * Ethereal and Wind imbues: Damage overrides to Ethereal, inflicts Haunted. * Decay and Poison imbues: Damage overrides to Decay, inflicts Curse.

name: Moment of Truth
description: High damage strike which ignores 50% of enemy resistances, player receives Drawback.
effects: = * High damage strike which deals 3.5x Damage and 0.5x Impact. * The attack ignores 50% of the enemy's Damage Resistance (not Protection or Barrier). Examples: An enemy with 30% damage resistances would take damage as if they have 15% damage resistances, and an enemy with 95% damage resistance would take damage as if they had 47.5% damage resistances. Additionally, if the resistance is below 0%, then the effect is deactivated. ** Note: Resistance modifiers (such as Pain) are applied before the halving effect of .

name: Scalp Collector
description: Inflicts Bleeding on hit. Kills with this attack grant Kill Streak.
effects: = * Strike with the axe, dealing 1.2x Damage and 0.1x Impact * Kills with this attack grant Kill Streak

name: Splitter
description: Leaping strike that grants short immunity and increases in power as the enemy's life % decreases.
effects: = * Leaping strike, granting immunity during the animation. * Impact is multiplied by 1.5x regardless of enemy Health. * Damage is multiplied by up to 6.0x depending on target enemy's Health %. For example, if enemy is at 100% health it deals 1.0x damage, and at 0% health it would deal 6.0x Damage if the target wasn't already dead. * If your weapon is imbued, grants +15 bonus damage of the element of the imbue. * Burns 5 Stamina and 5 Health
multipliers: 1.0x to 6.0x Damage depending on target Health %.; 1.5x Impact regardless of enemy Health.

name: Strafing Run
description: Shoot the bow 5 times rapidly, while strafing left or right.
effects: = * As the description states, simply run to the left or right while rapidly shooting 5 shots from your Bow.

name: The Technique
description: Unleash a flurry of 6 rapid strikes. Burns 10 Stamina.
effects: = * Rapidly strike 6 times with the sword, dealing 0.8x Damage and 0.25x Impact per hit * Burns 10 Stamina (in addition to the natural Stamina burn from the 30 stamina cost of activation)

name: Vicious Cycle
description: High impact strike, inflicts Crippled and Slow Down.
effects: = * High impact strike dealing 2.0x Damage and 3.0x Impact

name: Vital Crash
description: Long distance tackle, dealing more damage and impact the more health and stamina you have. Inflicts Pain and Confusion on the player.
effects: = * A long-distance running tackle. * Damage multiplied by 0.03x, and then multiplied by your Character's current Health. For example at 100 health it would be 3.0x Damage. At 200 Health, it would be 6.0x damage. This is not %-based as the description indicates, but a direct multiplier from your current health. * Impact uses the same multiplier as Damage, but based on your current Stamina. *Player receives 100% buildup for both Pain and Confusion. *The player won't get the statuses from this ability alone if they have any amount of Status Resistance.
multipliers: 0.03x Damage * Player's Health; 0.03x Impact * Player's Stamina

name: Warrior's Vein
description: Counter an attack. If successful, strike back with high damage and impact, and inflict Extreme Bleeding on yourself and the enemy.
effects: = * Counter deals 2.0x Damage and 2.5x Impact. *Applies 100% buildup for Extreme Bleeding to both the player and the target. *The player won't get the status from this ability alone if they have any amount of Status Resistance.

name: Enrage
description: Grants the Rage boon, which increases the Impact of your attacks. Using this skill burns a bit of your maximum health until the next time you sleep. Certain skills require this boon to be active.

name: Evasion Shot
description: Jumps backwards and shoot an arrow; Inflicts Cripple on target
effects: * Shoot while jumping backwards

name: Hunter's Eye
description: * The effect grants you double (2.0x) bow range. It has no effect on non-bow targeting range, however you can cast skills while locked with a bow.

name: Sniper Shot
description: Required: Bow. Let loose a very strong arrow shot with a long windup, making it a poor option in the middle of combat.
effects: * Long-range sniper shot * Damage multiplier: 2.5x * Impact multiplier: 3.0x
